answer_1.quote: We propose a new query-focused table summarization task, and construct a large-scale benchmark, QTSUMM, comprising 7,111 query-summary pairs collected in real-world situations.

answer_2.quote: We adopt following popular automated evaluation metrics: BLEU ... ROUGE ... METEOR ... BERTScore ... TAPAS-Acc ... AutoACU ... A3CU ...

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, the summaries from different models were evaluated by experts from three criteria (i.e., comprehensiveness, faithfulness, and fluency) that have been discussed in Section 3.2.
answer_4.guideline: experts evaluated summaries on three criteria: comprehensiveness, faithfulness, and fluency
